title: I Want to Die but I Still Want to Eat Tteokbokki
description: Bloomsbury presents I Want to Die but I Still Want to Eat Tteokbokki by Baek Sehee, read by Jully Lee.The sequel to the internationally bestselling South Korean therapy memoir, translated by National Book Award finalist Anton Hur.Whenever depression or emptiness came calling, I was all too eager to open the door of self-pity and go right inside.
